title: The Valley Where Questions Come to Rest

features.name: meeting place
features.desc-on-touch: A simple structure—a pub or a hall or a commons building. The walls are covered with questions carved, written, whispered into crevices. Some are centuries old. None have answers pinned beside them.

features.name: echo-pool
features.desc-on-touch: A depression where questions are thrown to hear them return. But this pool returns them changed, wiser, or sadder. You're not sure the question is the same anymore.

features.name: rest-marker
features.desc-on-touch: A monument or cairn, humble, with the inscription 'Here the question learns to rest.' Below, a list of questions that gave up their demand for answer. They seem peaceful.

features.name: archive-stack
features.desc-on-touch: Stacked records—court transcripts, hearing notes, incident reports. Each one documents an unanswered question. The stack grows, and nobody minds anymore.

features.name: silence-tower
features.desc-on-touch: Built from stone and patience. Tall enough that questions whispered into its base echo into the sky and never come back. Not a vault. A release.

inscription: the question learned to love the valley more than the answer

file.name: LocalMysteries_Unresolved_Registry_1950s-Present.txt
file.note: A civic log of incidents, mysteries, disappearances—all unsolved. Entries grow more philosophical as years pass. Later notes read like reflections on the beauty of not-knowing. The last entry: 'Perhap
